name: HZ_GEO_TERRITORIES_INT
description: hz_geo_territories_int is an interface table to load Territory Geography data to TCA geography tables such as HZ_GEOGRAPHIES,  HZ_RELATIONSHIPS, and HZ_HIERARCHY_NODES.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for  territory geographies/zone  import batch in HZ_IMP_BATCH_SUMMARY.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_OR_ZONE_NAME
columns.description: Primary name of the geography or zone.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_OR_ZONE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Geography or Zone.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_OR_ZONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type code of Geography or Zone.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: User identifier for the geography Zone.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_USE
columns.description: Usage of geography data.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: User identifier for the geography / Zone.

columns.name: PARENT_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: User identifier for the parent  geography / Zone.

columns.name: LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Country structure level number.

columns.name: GEO_LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Geography structure level number.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier of the parent used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of parent geography (internal use only).

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_USE
columns.description: Usage of parent geography (internal use only).

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Relationship identifier for this geography/zone and its parent in HZ_RELATIONSHIPS table (internal use only)

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this territory geography / zone  is valid for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date date from which this territory geography / zone is no longer valid.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs.

columns.name: COUNTRY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Country to which the Geography belongs.

columns.name: GEO_PARENT_NAME1
columns.description: Name of  the parent geography used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: GEO_PARENT_NAME2
columns.description: Name of  the parent geography used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.description: Name of  the parent geography used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: GEO_PARENT_NAME4
columns.description: Name of  the parent geography used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: GEO_PARENT_NAME5
columns.description: Name of  the parent geography used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: CHILD_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE_CODE1
columns.description: Geography type of the child geography (internal use only).

columns.description: Geography type of the child geography (internal use only).

columns.description: Geography type of the child geography (internal use only).

columns.name: CHILD_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE_CODE5

columns.name: INCLUDE_CHILD_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE1
columns.description: Geography type of the child geography (internal use only).

columns.name: INCLUDE_CHILD_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE2
columns.description: Geography type of the child geography (internal use only).

columns.name: INCLUDE_CHILD_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE3

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the language in which identifier_value is stored. (Foreign key to FND_ LANGUAGES.LANGUAGE_CODE)

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated (internal use only).

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Error ID in HZ_IMP_ERRORS. (internal use only)

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the hz_geo_territories_int table.(internal use only)

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File import wizard uses this column to relate records in this interface table to rows in a file. (internal use only)

columns.name: GEO_ROOT_PARENT_ID
columns.description: Unique  identifier of the root geography / Zone (internal use only).

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This is an optional column for multi-csv uptake, but recommended. The column saves the individual sys task id for each input csv file, corresponding to value in the mkt_cm_systask table. This value will be populated by the import framework

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: File import wizard status: I - In Progress,  O - Obsolete(This would be the status of all the interface table records that were run before),  E - Errored, S - Successful (internal use only)

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
